meta_title: PhishLens: ga dalilin da yasa imel yake phishing
meta_desc: Ƙarin Chrome kyauta mai buɗaɗɗen tushe wanda ke duba imel a Gmail da Outlook kuma yana nuna dalili: rubutu, hanyoyin haɗi, tabbatar da mai aikawa da haɗe-haɗe.
og_desc: Ƙarin Chrome mai buɗaɗɗen tushe don Gmail da Outlook: hukunci a saman kowane imel, maki ɗaya ga kowane bincike, da kalmomi da alamun da ke bayan sa.
og_alt: PhishLens: ga dalilin da yasa imel yake phishing. Gmail da Outlook.
skip: Tsallaka zuwa abin da ke ciki
footer_text: PhishLens. Kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe, lasisin GNU AGPL-3.0. Babu kukis a wannan shafin.
hero_tag: Ƙarin Chrome · Gmail + Outlook · harsuna 8 · buɗaɗɗen tushe
hero_h1: Ga dalilin da yasa imel yake phishing.
hero_lead: PhishLens yana ƙara hukunci a saman kowane imel a Gmail da Outlook: maki ɗaya ga kowane bincike, alamun da ya samu, da kalmomin da suka fi nauyi. Danna Duba, ko bari ya duba sababbin imel da kansa.
shot_alt: Tutoci biyu na PhishLens a saman imel a Gmail. Na farko ya ce imel ɗin yana kama da phishing, da maki 97% na rubutu, 88% na hanyoyin haɗi da 74% na mai aikawa, alamomi na gano Safe Browsing, gazawar DMARC da kasancewa cikin jerin Spamhaus, da kalmomin da suka kawo hukuncin. Na biyu ya ce imel ɗin yana kama da amintacce saboda mai aikawa yana cikin jerin amintattu.
shot_caption: Tutar da PhishLens ke ƙarawa a saman imel (zanen ainihin manhajar, da Turanci; gwada irin wannan bincike a ƙasa).
r_langs: harsunan da aka gwada da phishing na gaske (samfurin rubutu yana karanta 22)
r_caught: na phishing da cikakken tsarin ya gano, a imel na baya-bayan nan da babu wanda ya duba
r_latency: matsakaicin lokacin bincike na imel na yau da kullum a sabar da ba ta da GPU
r_false: na imel na halal da aka yi wa alama a matsayin phishing (1 cikin 414)
results_note_html: An auna a PhishLens Cloud ranar 24 ga Oktoba, 2026 da benchmark na jama'a: imel na phishing 1,812 daga cikin 2,000 na baya-bayan nan, a harsuna da dama, waɗanda babu wanda ya duba lokacin gyare-gyare (tazarar amincewa ta 95%: 89.2% zuwa 91.8%), da imel na halal 1 daga cikin 414 (297 daga jerin aikawa na jama'a, 117 daga akwatunan gaske; 0.0% zuwa 1.4%). Lokacin bincike shi ne matsakaici na imel na yau da kullum (kusan tokens 250); gajeren imel yana ɗaukar kusan 65 ms. Ƙiyasi ne, ba tabbaci ba: duba yadda aka auna da iyakokin da aka sani.
live_note: An karanta daga sabar lokacin da shafin ya buɗe. Ƙididdigar tana komawa sifili idan sabar ta sake farawa.
checks_intro: Imel na gaske daga bankuna da jami'o'i suna amfani da kalmomi iri ɗaya da phishing, don haka samfurin rubutu shi kaɗai yana yi musu alama. PhishLens yana duba shaida kafin ya yanke hukunci.
chk_wording: Samfuri mai harsuna da yawa (mmBERT-small, an ciro shi daga babban mai gano phishing) yana ba rubutu maki a harsuna 22; LIME yana nuna kalmomin da suka karkatar da hukuncin.
chk_links: Kowace ainihin hanyar haɗi, har da wadda ke bayan "Danna nan", ana duba ta a Safe Browsing, PhishTank, URLhaus da Spamhaus.
chk_sender: SPF, DKIM da DMARC suna nuna wanda ya aiko shi da gaske. Imel da aka tura ba ya ɗaukar amincewar wanda ya tura shi.
chk_att: PDF (har da waɗanda aka ɗauki hoto, ta OCR), lambobin QR, macros da samfuran nesa na Office, ma'ajiyar ZIP, RAR da 7z, da gayyatar kalanda.
chk_inbox: Tattaunawa, imel na hotuna kawai, da hanyoyin haɗi zuwa fayilolin da aka raba a Drive, OneDrive ko Dropbox.
popup_alt: Tagar PhishLens bayan duba imel: hukuncin phishing, maki ɗaya ga kowane bincike, alamomin bayanan barazana da kalmomin da ke bayan hukuncin.
popup_caption: Tagar ƙarin, don fayiloli da rubutun da aka liƙa.
att_alt: Sakamakon haɗe-haɗe a ƙarƙashin imel: takardar biyan kuɗi ta PDF da aka ɗauki hoto mai lambar QR da aka yi wa alamar phishing, takardar Word mai macros da aka yi wa alamar phishing, da PDF da aka ce amintacce ne.
att_caption: Sakamakon haɗe-haɗe, ana nuna su a ƙarƙashin haɗe-haɗen imel.
f_explain: Maki ɗaya ga kowane bincike, alamun da aka samu, da kalmomin da suka karkatar da samfurin rubutu, don ka yanke hukunci da kanka.
f_mail: Maɓallin Duba kusa da jigo a Gmail da Outlook a yanar gizo; fayiloli da rubutun da aka liƙa a tagar ƙarin.
f_auto: Na zaɓi: ana duba sababbin imel idan sun iso, ana yi musu alamar Amintacce ko Phishing? a jerin, tare da sanarwa.
f_private: Babu asusu. Ana duba imel a ƙwaƙwalwa kuma ba a ajiye su ba; tarihinka yana zama a burauzarka. Da sabarka ta kanka, babu imel da zai bar kwamfutarka.
f_acc: Nuna ko kowane hukunci daidai ne ko ba daidai ba, ka ga yadda PhishLens ke aiki a kan imel ɗinka na gaske, tare da fitarwa ta CSV.
f_open: Lasisin GNU AGPL-3.0, tare da samfurin barazana, CodeQL da gwaje-gwaje na atomatik sama da 300 a kowane canji.
how_read: Rubutun, ainihin inda hanyoyin haɗi ke zuwa, mai aikawa, kuma a Gmail, cikakkun kanun saƙo na asali.
how_score: Samfuri mai harsuna da yawa don kalmomi, samfuri da dokoki don hanyoyin haɗi, dokoki don mai aikawa da inda hanyoyin haɗin ke kai wa.
how_verify: Sakamakon tabbatarwa da majiyoyin bayanan barazana guda huɗu, kafin kowane hukunci.
how_explain: Hukunci, maki ɗaya ga kowane bincike, alamun da aka samu da kalmomin da ke bayan sa, a saman imel.
try_intro: Wannan fom yana amfani da sabar ɗaya da ƙarin. Ba a ajiye komai, amma don Allah yi amfani da imel na gwaji, ba na sirri ba.
drop_title: Jefa fayil a nan, ko danna don zaɓar ɗaya
drop_types: Imel .eml, PDF, hoto, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP, RAR, 7z ko .ics
drop_limit: Mafi yawa 10 MB. Ana dubawa, ba a taɓa ajiyewa.
file_hint: Babu abin zaɓa? Koma Liƙa rubutu ka yi amfani da misali.
result_empty: Hukuncin, makin kowane bincike da kalmomin da ke bayan sa za su bayyana a nan.
install_intro: PhishLens bai riga ya shiga Chrome Web Store ba: ka loda shi da hannu, yana ɗaukar kusan minti biyu.
install_s1_html: Sauke PhishLens-extension-….zip daga sabuwar siga ka buɗe shi.
install_s2_html: Buɗe chrome://extensions ka kunna Developer mode (sama a dama).
install_s3_html: Danna Load unpacked ka zaɓi babban fayil ɗin da ka buɗe.
install_s4_html: Buɗe imel a Gmail ko Outlook a yanar gizo ka danna Duba da PhishLens kusa da jigo.
backend_own_html: Taka ta kanka, ta sirri: kunna ta da Docker, sannan ka zaɓi Local a saitunan ƙarin.
install_more_html: Python ba tare da Docker ba, saituna da girkawa: duba jagorar farawa (da Turanci).
privacy_desc: Abin da ƙarin PhishLens, shafin yanar gizo da PhishLens Cloud ke sarrafawa, inda yake zuwa da abin da ake ajiyewa.
terms_desc: Sharuɗɗan amfani da ƙarin PhishLens, shafin yanar gizo da PhishLens Cloud.
legal_note_html: An bayar da wannan fassarar don sauƙi. Idan ta bambanta da sigar Turanci, sigar Turanci ce ke aiki.
nf_title: Ba a sami shafin ba · PhishLens

nf_p2_html: Za ka iya zuwa shafin farko, duba imel, ko karanta manufar sirri.
